items.nl: Su-24, twee boten, 40 commandoposten en tientallen luchtverdedigings-, radar- en EW-middelen: resultaten van 'middle strike' in september (ArmyInform)
items.sEn: Ukraine's Ministry of Defence has published a September tally of its 'middle strike' campaign. According to the ministry, Ukraine's Defence Forces hit more than 30 Russian air-defence, radar and electronic-warfare assets, 40 command posts and more than 50 logistics targets during the month. items.en: Ukraine strikes two Pantsir-S1 systems, radar station, drone facilities and engine plant
items.nl: Oekraïne raakt twee Pantsir-S1-systemen, radarstation, drone-faciliteiten en motorenfabriek
items.sEn: On 11 September 2026, Ukraine's General Staff reported a series of simultaneous precision strikes on multiple Russian targets.
